reason: I am two waiters short and my problem this month is hiring, not loyalty rewards or dish ratings. I might take the free listing and staff board, but I won't put my thin team through new payment training for a 39-lari plan I can't prove pays back.
objection: I already hire through jobs.ge and Instagram, and I don't know if the Keepz fee beats my card terminal or if guests here will actually scan a QR instead of handing over a card.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the written Keepz fee lower than my terminal, plus the staff board actually bringing me a waiter, would make me try the free months and maybe keep the 29-lari plan.
